block.theoreticalsciences.abiogenesis_cr: A crucible of primordial soup under lightning and ultraviolet light, held where chemistry tips over into life.
block.theoreticalsciences.absolute_frame: A machine casing: the shell a structure is built from. Hold Shift to see which structures use it.
block.theoreticalsciences.absolute_pedes: A pedestal of the Convergence ritual, of the highest grade: set an item on it around a Convergence Altar.
block.theoreticalsciences.aleph_glass.lo: Glass whose clarity has a cardinality. It holds countably many points of light in a perfectly ordered grid, yet every sliver of it still contains as many points as the whole.
block.theoreticalsciences.analytic_conti: Calculus in a box: limits, derivatives, integrals, series and the analytic continuation of functions into the complex plane.
block.theoreticalsciences.annihilation_r: Converts mass entirely into energy, E = mc^2, regulated by dilithium crystals.
block.theoreticalsciences.anomaly_contai: A quarantine cell of chronoplastic walls, causal shielding and windows of containment glass, with dimensional stabilisers at every corner. It lets what it holds grow - just slower than its field can clear it.
block.theoreticalsciences.anomaly_resolu: A tower of reality-lattice casing around a column of lensed, error-corrected fields. It doses an anomaly fraction by fraction until not one of its cells is left, and writes what it learned back into the laws.
block.theoreticalsciences.answer_pedesta: A plinth that waits for a conclusion. When the right answer is placed on it, the surrounding proof settles into consistency and the room grows quiet. A wrong answer sits there and does nothing at all.
block.theoreticalsciences.anticarbon_ore: Anticarbon Ore. Found in the Antiverse, between Y -60 and 20. Gives Anticarbon Crystal when mined. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antigold_ore.l: Anti-Gold Ore. Found in the Antiverse, between Y -48 and 60. Gives Raw Anti-Gold when mined. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antihydrogen_i: Antihydrogen Ice. Found in the Antiverse, between Y 20 and 160. Gives Antihydrogen Crystal when mined. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antiiron_ore.l: Anti-Iron Ore. Found in the Antiverse, between Y -48 and 120. Gives Raw Anti-Iron when mined. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antimatter_pen: Pair-produces antimatter from gamma photons and holds it in a magnetic bottle.
block.theoreticalsciences.antiproton_dec: A ring that catches antiprotons from collisions at nearly light speed and brakes them, lap after lap, until they can be trapped.
block.theoreticalsciences.antisilicon_or: Antisilicon Ore. Found in the Antiverse, between Y -20 and 100. Gives Antisilicon Shard when mined. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.antisoil.lore: Antisoil: the ground of one of the strange places beyond the Overworld.
block.theoreticalsciences.antistone.lore: Antistone: the ground of one of the strange places beyond the Overworld.
block.theoreticalsciences.antistone_bric: Antistone Bricks: a building block of the strange places, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.antiverse_cach: A cache of the Antiverse. Open it to see what the place left behind.
block.theoreticalsciences.antiwater.lore: Antiwater, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.arbor_heartwoo: The innermost wood of the Arbor, dense and pale, with rings that record not years but the branching of possibilities. Run a finger along the grain and it follows a different branch each time.
block.theoreticalsciences.arbor_planks.l: Planks cut from the Arbor, pale and fine-grained, with faint branching lines running along their length. The wood smells of rain and seems to grow warmer when people walk across it.
block.theoreticalsciences.arbor_planks_s: A slab of Arbor Planks, for building with.
Stairs of Arbor Planks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.autocatalytic_: Autocatalytic Broth, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.autonomous_ext: An Extreme Assembly Table that crafts on its own: give it a pattern, feed it, power it.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiom_distille: Boils reality down past its source code to the axioms underneath, and condenses them into fragments.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiom_lamp.lor: A lamp that shines when its axiom is in force. Its light is steady and colourless, and when the axiom is withdrawn it simply goes dark. Rows of them read like a truth table drawn in light.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiom_stone.lo: Pale, smooth stone that seems to be made of definitions. Each block holds its shape because it has been told to. It is cool and faintly humming, like a theorem being proved.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiom_toggle.l: A switch that adopts or rejects an axiom. Flip it and the local truths rearrange; some things become provable, others not.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiomatic_brea: Breaks every law of physics and mathematics at once. While it runs, step into its heart to fall out of reality.
block.theoreticalsciences.axiomatic_fiel: A field emitter that projects not forces but rules - a small region where a chosen axiom holds or does not.
block.theoreticalsciences.bioreactor.lor: A sterile, stirred, temperature-held vat where cells grow and do the chemistry for you.
block.theoreticalsciences.bose_einstein_: Bose-Einstein Condensate, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
Cools atoms to nanokelvin until they share a single quantum state.
block.theoreticalsciences.breached_anoma: Ruins of a machine that broke more than itself. Its frame is torn, and from the tears leak fragments of rules that no longer apply anywhere.
block.theoreticalsciences.bubble_univers: A sphere of an entirely separate universe, nucleated out of the inflating vacuum and sealed off from ours. Inside it, the constants are slightly different.
block.theoreticalsciences.bulk_cache.lor: Bigger on the inside - it borrows a little room from a fifth dimension.
block.theoreticalsciences.bulk_crystal.l: A translucent crystal from the Bulk whose facets seem to point in directions I cannot quite name.
block.theoreticalsciences.bulk_stone.lor: The bedrock of the higher-dimensional Bulk: a grey stone that seems to have more surfaces than it shows. Edges blur where the extra dimensions curl back in.
block.theoreticalsciences.calorimeter_de: An array of scintillator crystals and pixel trackers that records where a particle went and how much energy it carried. A quantum processor reads the flashes. The crystals glow faintly when hit.
block.theoreticalsciences.cantor_diagona: Lists every number, then builds one that is on no list. Manufactures infinities - and then bigger ones.
block.theoreticalsciences.carborane_supe: Carborane Superacid, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.cardinal_ore.l: Rather than order, this ore measures size. Found in the Transfinite Hierarchy, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Cardinal Shard when mined. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.casimir_energy: An energy store built around the force between two plates in a vacuum.
Presses matter between plates so close the vacuum itself pushes back.
block.theoreticalsciences.causal_shieldi: A plate of chronosteel and causal shield lattice that keeps cause and effect in the right order on either side. It feels slightly ahead of the moment, as though it knew I was going to touch it.
Causal Solder, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.causality_loop: Sends objects back along a closed timelike curve so they exist twice. The universe is not amused.
block.theoreticalsciences.chemical_react: A pressure vessel with a catalyst bed, a heater and a stirrer. Most of chemistry is getting the right molecules to meet at the right energy.
block.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_bric: Cherenkov quartz cut into small bricks, each one glowing softly blue along its edges. A wall of them looks like a shallow pool at night. They are smooth and slightly cool to the touch.
A slab of Cherenkov Bricks, for building with.
Stairs of Cherenkov Bricks, for building with.
A wall of Cherenkov Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_lamp: A lamp of Cherenkov quartz with glowstone at its heart, so the blue Cherenkov glow is amplified into a strong, clean light. It is the colour of a reactor pool, and as calming.
block.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_pill: A column of Cherenkov quartz that glows along its length with an even blue. Placed at a doorway it reads like a beam of light holding up the lintel. It is cool and faintly humming.
block.theoreticalsciences.cherenkov_quar: Nine pieces of Cherenkov quartz fused into a single block that glows the soft blue of particles outrunning light in a medium.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronal_accele: Time runs up to 256x faster for everything in its field. Every extra tick costs energy and Chronon Gas.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronal_field_: A projector that stretches time in its field. A temporal knot sits in the emitter stack, so clocks inside run faster or slower depending on its setting.
block.theoreticalsciences.chrono_loom.lo: Weaves worldlines. Reverses the arrow of time, ties temporal knots and enforces self-consistency on time loops.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronon_field_: Inverts the local arrow of time to harvest chronons.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronoplastic_: A casing laced with tachyon crystal and a chronon capacitor, so that time inside flows at a rate I can adjust.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_bl: Nine chronosteel ingots fused into one block, a metal whose atoms keep slightly different time from their surroundings.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_co: A superconducting coil wrapped in chronosteel, so that current inside it runs on its own clock. The field it makes is steadier than any ordinary coil, as though the coil had more time to think.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_ha: A chronosteel panel painted with warning stripes, used to mark doorways, machine edges and anything I do not want to walk into. The stripes look very slightly out of step with each other.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_pi: A column of chronosteel, banded and fluted, that carries a load without complaint. It reflects light in a slightly delayed blur and gives a doorway the feel of an engine room.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_pl: Chronosteel rolled into plates and fixed to a block face. Its sheen is cool and slightly blurred, as if the surface had moved a moment before it was seen. It gives a wall a clean, mechanical look.
A slab of Chronosteel Plating, for building with.
Stairs of Chronosteel Plating, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.chronosteel_ve: A chronosteel grille that lets air pass between rooms. The slats are angled to keep light out and air moving, and a faint draught always seems to be flowing through it, even when the room is still.
block.theoreticalsciences.cloaking_glass: A pane of metamaterial that bends light around itself, so the glass is nearly invisible from any angle. Only the edges betray it, as a faint distortion in the room.
block.theoreticalsciences.compactificati: Rolls extra dimensions up small: Kaluza-Klein circles, Calabi-Yau and G₂ spaces, D-branes and finally M-theory itself.
block.theoreticalsciences.computronium_b: A block of matter arranged so that every atom is part of a computation. It is warm to the touch and very slightly noisy, as though it is always working.
block.theoreticalsciences.computronium_l: A computronium block lit from within by glowstone, its traces brightened into a steady, warm glow. It looks like a terminal screen turned into a lamp.
block.theoreticalsciences.computronium_p: A panel of computronium with fine glowing traces running across its face, like a circuit board that is thinking. It is warm and faintly busy to the touch.
block.theoreticalsciences.computronium_t: Computronium cut into tiles, each one lit by faint, shifting traces. A floor of them flickers softly, as if computing something about whoever walks across it.
A slab of Computronium Tiles, for building with.
Stairs of Computronium Tiles, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.concept_compre: Takes whole stacks of everything a field of science has produced and compresses them into a single singularity of pure concept.
block.theoreticalsciences.conceptual_cas: Housing for things that are not physical. Its plates are woven from transfinite structure and braced with formal proofs, so that what it contains is held by consistency rather than by strength.
block.theoreticalsciences.containment_fi: Glass that is not really glass, but a field held between two panes with a shimmer of plasma in between.
block.theoreticalsciences.convergence_al: The heart of the Convergence ritual: the pedestals around it give up their items to make what is set on it.
block.theoreticalsciences.convergence_en: Does in a box what the Convergence Altar does with pedestals and patience: every convergence ritual, fed by pipes like any machine.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_neutron: Nine ingots of cosmic neutronium fused into a block denser than the inside of a neutron star. It is hard to pick up and harder to put down gently. It casts a faint, cold shadow even in full light.
A coil of cosmic neutronium over spacetime alloy, cooled cryogenically and threaded with pentaquark shards. It runs hotter than anything below it and seems to pull faintly on the room.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_plating: Cosmic neutronium rolled into plating, dark as space with faint pinpricks of light. A wall of it looks like a window onto the night sky that happens to be load-bearing.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_tiles.l: Cosmic neutronium cut into dark tiles that seem to have tiny points of light deep inside them, like stars seen through a deep well. The floor they make feels impossibly solid.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_tiles_s: A slab of Cosmic Neutronium Tiles, for building with.
Stairs of Cosmic Neutronium Tiles, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.cosmogenic_cas: A casing built to contain the birth of a universe. Spin foam lattice, multiverse shard and cosmic neutronium are folded over a hyperlattice frame, around rift frame casing.
block.theoreticalsciences.cryogenic_cool: A jacket of containment field glass around a cryocooler, built to keep superconducting parts close to absolute zero. Frost forms on its outer face within seconds.
block.theoreticalsciences.dark_energy_si: Taps the energy of empty space that drives the expansion of the universe.
block.theoreticalsciences.dark_matter_co: Gravitationally focuses the invisible halo surrounding every galaxy.
block.theoreticalsciences.deepslate_cher: Deepslate Cherenkov Quartz Ore. Found in the Overworld, between Y -64 and 0. Gives Cherenkov Quartz when mined. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.degenerate_mat: End stone cracked around knots of matter so compressed that its electrons are packed into the lowest states quantum mechanics permits. Found in the End, between Y 10 and 80. Gives Degenerate Matter Chunk when mined. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.dilaton_ore.lo: Pale, oddly variable mineral whose hardness seems to drift as I handle it. Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 160. Gives Dilaton Crystal when mined. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.dilithium_bloc: Dilithium crystals fused into one solid block that rings when struck and glows a soft violet. The resonance carries through the floor, and anything metal nearby picks up a faint hum.
block.theoreticalsciences.dilithium_lamp: A dilithium block with glowstone at its centre, so the violet crystal shines with a soft, even light. It hums a single note when lit.
Dilithium Ore. Found in the Nether, between Y 10 and 110. Gives Dilithium Crystal when mined. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.dimensional_li: A lift that pushes along an extra dimension. With a tesseract core set inside the emitter stack, it can nudge anything in its field slightly outside ordinary space, where weight no longer applies.
block.theoreticalsciences.dimensional_re: Dimensional Residue, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.dimensional_st: A stabiliser that holds the number of dimensions in a region fixed while machines nearby try to change it. A dimensional stabiliser matrix sets the count, and a field emitter enforces it.
block.theoreticalsciences.dipole_bending: A superconducting dipole magnet on a neutronium frame that bends a charged particle beam into a circle. Its field is perfectly uniform across the gap. Metal tools drift toward it.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_black_: A real one, very small, held on a pedestal. It bends the light behind it.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_dyson_: A star wrapped in a swarm of collectors.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_galaxy: Two hundred billion stars, more or less, in two spiral arms.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_penter: The shadow of a five-dimensional cube. It has 32 corners and 80 edges.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_pocket: A whole universe, still expanding, in a jar.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_pulsar: A neutron star spinning hundreds of times a second, sweeping its beams across the room.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_quasar: A feeding black hole outshining its host galaxy.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_tesser: A four-dimensional cube turning through itself.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_white_: Nothing can enter it. Light pours out forever.
block.theoreticalsciences.display_wormho: The other mouth is somewhere else. Do not put your hand in.
block.theoreticalsciences.dyson_array.lo: Surrounds a captive star with a swarm, and eventually a sphere, of collectors.
block.theoreticalsciences.einstein_rosen: A wormhole made solid: one mouth here, the other somewhere far away, joined by a throat through curved spacetime. Peering into it, I see the far side foreshortened and tinted.
block.theoreticalsciences.ejecta_cache.l: Thrown out of a white hole with everything else. It has never been opened from outside.
block.theoreticalsciences.ejecta_ore.lor: Scorched nuggets blown out of a white hole. Found in the White Hole Interior, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Primordial Ejecta when mined. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.ejecta_rock.lo: Stone thrown outward from somewhere nothing should leave. Its grains are shocked and blistered, as if fired out of a white hole, and the strata run backwards: newest at the bottom, oldest on top.
block.theoreticalsciences.electrolytic_c: Two electrodes in a conducting liquid: drive a current through it and it comes apart into what it was made of.
block.theoreticalsciences.entangled_rela: Two halves of a quantum pair, each locked inside a small housing. Whatever happens to one is correlated with the other, however far apart they sit.
block.theoreticalsciences.entangled_tran: Sends to (or receives from) every other transceiver on the same channel, at any distance. Sneak-use to switch between sending and receiving; an Entanglement Tuner sets the channel.
block.theoreticalsciences.entropy_horizo: A ring of event-horizon casing that runs a universe forward to its end: stars burn out, protons decay, black holes evaporate, and the horizon glows at its own faint temperature over what is left.
block.theoreticalsciences.essence_distil: A tower of fractionation trays wound with chronosteel coils. Pour in every fluid one mod has and it boils them together, tray after tray, until what is left is a single fluid that stands for all of them: that mod's Essence.
block.theoreticalsciences.euclid_reliqua: A reliquary of perfect proportions. Its lid closes on an exact right angle.
block.theoreticalsciences.event_horizon_: A casing with a dark metamaterial skin over spacetime casing and neutronium plate: whatever reaches it from inside does not come back out.
block.theoreticalsciences.evolution_engi: A biodome where generations of designed life live and die in seconds. Run it inside a fast chronal field and a million years pass in a minute.
block.theoreticalsciences.ex_nihilo_engi: Creation from nothing, made a machine. It does not convert energy - it simply has it.
Exotic Matter, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
Exotic Solder, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.extreme_assemb: A crafting table with a 9x9 grid, for the recipes too large for any other.
block.theoreticalsciences.eye_of_the_hor: A captive black hole wrapped in anchors, lenses and stabilisers, used as a computer: it simulates entire stars, galaxies and universes, and keeps what falls out.
block.theoreticalsciences.false_vacuum.l: False Vacuum, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.femto_fabricat: Builds components smaller than a proton - and assembles them into processors.
block.theoreticalsciences.femtoscale_ass: A long line of robotic arms and fabrication heads for the most complex assemblies: high-tier processors and late-game machine controllers.
A compact emitter of neutronium plate, Cherenkov quartz and a quantum dot that projects a field shaped by the dot's quantum state. Change the state, change the field.
block.theoreticalsciences.foam_bubble.lo: A pocket of space sitting in a higher-energy vacuum than its surroundings, metastable and patient. Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256.
block.theoreticalsciences.foam_cache.lor: Held together by a bubble of stable vacuum. Do not leave it open long.
block.theoreticalsciences.foam_substrate: Spongy, effervescent matter scooped from below the Planck length. Bubbles of spacetime swell and vanish inside it so fast the block seems to fizz without making a sound.
block.theoreticalsciences.forged_omnipot: An Omnipotence Core forged anew. Unbreakable; only the Hand of the Demiurge can attune, wake or move it.
block.theoreticalsciences.fractal_lattic: A block of the Platonic Realm's fractal lattice, for building with - and an ingredient of its machines.
block.theoreticalsciences.fractal_ore.lo: A vein that never resolves. Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 0 and 200. Gives Fractal Dust when mined. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.fractionation_: A casing of containment field glass and chronosteel over event horizon casing, made to separate fluids by mass and charge in a tall spire. Watching through the glass, the layers settle into neat bands.
A tall distillation spire that separates Dimensional Residue and Warm Helium into useful fractions.
block.theoreticalsciences.fractured_real: What a failing multiblock leaks: a higher-dimensional shadow that spreads from block to block like an infection.
block.theoreticalsciences.frozen_light_o: Photons that fell toward a horizon and appear to have stopped. Found in the Black Hole Interior, between Y 20 and 256. Gives Frozen Photon when mined. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.gene_sequencer: Reads a genome letter by letter - and, run backwards, writes one.
block.theoreticalsciences.golden_ratio_g: Glass made with a transcendental crystal so that its proportions follow the golden ratio at every scale. Each pane is divided into smaller panes in the same ratio, forever.
block.theoreticalsciences.graviton_conde: Quantises gravity itself - gravitons, spin foam and the anchors of reality.
block.theoreticalsciences.graviton_field: A field emitter upgraded with a graviton crystal and a gravitic lens element, so it projects gravity as well as fields. It weighs more on one side than the other, and that side changes.
Projects a field around a structure; what the field is decides what the machine inside can do.
block.theoreticalsciences.graviton_lens_: An array of gravitic lens elements that bend spacetime to focus gravitational waves, the way a glass lens bends light. Inside, the space seems to pinch toward the centre.
block.theoreticalsciences.harmonic_pedes: A pedestal of the Convergence ritual: set an item on it around a Convergence Altar.
block.theoreticalsciences.hawking_radiat: A collector of Hawking absorber plates and entangled photons that catches the faint radiation evaporating black holes give off. It is warm, and the warmth comes from somewhere it should not.
block.theoreticalsciences.hex_glass.lore: Glass held together by a hexagonal force field, like a honeycomb of light. Each cell glows faintly at its edges. It is strong and very slightly warm to the touch.
block.theoreticalsciences.higgs_field_mo: Tunes the Higgs field locally to strip mass from matter - or make it negative.
Brick moulded to the standards of Hilbert's programme: every face a rigorous statement, every joint a valid inference.
block.theoreticalsciences.hilbert_locker: Always full, and always room for one more.
block.theoreticalsciences.holographic_en: Writes a volume of matter onto its own boundary surface, per the holographic principle.
Its lid is an event horizon held open. What goes in stays in - until you reach for it.
A pane cut from the boundary of no return. Light enters easily but seems reluctant to leave, so everything beyond looks slightly dimmed and stretched.
block.theoreticalsciences.hyperframe_cas: A casing laced with topological insulator and superposition crystal, so that its interior exists in several overlapping configurations at once.
block.theoreticalsciences.hypernova_plas: Hypernova Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.hyperreal_cach: Its walls obey whatever law is currently in force - the contents do not.
block.theoreticalsciences.hyperspherical: Spheres in four dimensions leave odd traces when they intersect our three. Found in the Transfinite Hierarchy, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Hypersphere Fragment when mined. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.infall_rock.lo: Rock stretched and compressed on its way toward a black hole. Its grains are elongated along one axis by tidal forces, and the light from it arrives reddened and slow.
block.theoreticalsciences.inflation_cham: A sphere of containment glass around a pocket of false vacuum, wound with coils and lensed by gravitons. The inflaton inside rolls down its potential slowly enough to inflate - and then it reheats, and a universe's worth of matter is made.
block.theoreticalsciences.interface_port: Takes the place of a structure's block to let items, fluids and energy in and out (or to link an ME network).
block.theoreticalsciences.ionic_liquid.l: Ionic Liquid, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.kaluza_klein_o: Kaluza-Klein Ore. Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 160. Gives Kaluza-Klein Shard when mined. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.koch_crystal.l: A pane whose rim is a Koch snowflake: a finite area enclosed by an infinitely long border. The glass is clear, but its edge glitters endlessly as each tiny triangle catches light.
block.theoreticalsciences.kugelblitz_cha: Focuses so much light into one point that it collapses into a black hole.
block.theoreticalsciences.lattice_growth: Grows flawless single-crystal boules atom by atom in a superfluid bath.
block.theoreticalsciences.liquid_antihel: Liquid Antihelium, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.liquid_spaceti: Liquid Spacetime, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.lithography_gl: Containment field glass doped with quantum dots so that light passing through it is shaped at nanometre resolution. It projects patterns far finer than its own grain.
block.theoreticalsciences.logos_coil_blo: A coil wound of the Logos itself, for the last structures of all (the Pleroma Reconstitutor).
block.theoreticalsciences.magnetic_confi: A casing that holds plasma away from its own walls with superconducting magnetic fields, tuned by dilithium. It works on the same principle as a tokamak.
block.theoreticalsciences.matrioshka_bra: Nested shells of computronium around a star. It thinks; you gain Insight.
block.theoreticalsciences.maxwell_demon_: A molecular gatekeeper that sorts fast particles from slow ones, defying the second law of thermodynamics.
block.theoreticalsciences.metallic_hydro: Liquid Metallic Hydrogen, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.metamaterial_w: Lays down sub-wavelength lattices that bend light (and gravity) the wrong way.
block.theoreticalsciences.mirror_foundry: A stack of Penning traps: anti-ores are melted, refined and cast without ever touching a wall - and matter and antimatter are bound into one alloy.
block.theoreticalsciences.moduli_ore.lor: Each crystal here is a snapshot of one possible shape for the hidden dimensions. Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 160. Gives Moduli Crystal when mined. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.multiverse_rif: Holds open a tear into neighbouring universes and harvests what leaks through.
block.theoreticalsciences.nanite_assembl: A molecular foundry that builds machines atom by atom - including machines that build themselves.
Nanite Slurry, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.neural_synthes: Grows photonic neural networks and the artificial minds that run on them.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutrino_conde: Traps the ghost particles that pass through planets without noticing.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutron_star_f: Recreates the crushing interior of a collapsed star: neutronium, metallic hydrogen and quark matter.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_blo: A cube of compacted neutronium, matter in which electrons and protons have been crushed together into neutrons.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_bri: Neutronium Bricks: a building block of the strange places, for building with.
A slab of Neutronium Bricks, for building with.
Stairs of Neutronium Bricks, for building with.
A wall of Neutronium Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_pil: A column of neutronium with fluted sides, built to carry loads that would buckle any ordinary pillar. It is heavy enough to feel rooted and smooth enough to feel cold.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_pla: Neutronium rolled into flat plates and riveted onto a block face. It is grey, dense and almost reflective, with seams that look as though they were drawn with a ruler.
A slab of Neutronium Plating, for building with.
Stairs of Neutronium Plating, for building with.
A wall of Neutronium Plating, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.neutronium_til: Neutronium cut into small square tiles and laid in a grid. The tiles are perfectly flat and very slightly cold, and footsteps on them sound muffled, as if the floor is absorbing more than sound.
A slab of Neutronium Tiles, for building with.
Stairs of Neutronium Tiles, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.nucleosynthesi: Takes a star through its whole life - collapse, ignition, giant phase, death - and keeps the elements it forges.
A heavy-ion accelerator firing into a spinning target: fuses nuclei into elements beyond the periodic table, aiming for the island of stability.
block.theoreticalsciences.nutrient_broth: Nutrient Broth, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.observatory_ca: A sealed stasis locker. Whoever left it here wanted what is inside to stay exactly as it was.
block.theoreticalsciences.observer_plate: A plate that collapses whatever stands on it. Step onto it and the surrounding superpositions resolve into definite states. It is smooth, unbreakable, and faintly cold, like an eye that never blinks.
block.theoreticalsciences.omega_simulato: Runs the whole confrontation with Alpha Omega again - inside a model of it. Shown one Proof of Everything as a template, it walks the argument once more and writes out another copy.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnilex_casing: The casing of the final machine: crystallised law and arbor heartwood bound over a transfinite casing with a transfinite weave. It looks like wood and glass and law at the same time.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnilex_engine: Simulates the World Tree and the Ocean of Primordial Law - and so controls them. Only works in Hyperdimensional Reality Space.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnipotence_ca: Material that cannot be broken because breaking it is not among the things that can happen. Tools pass over it without effect.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnipotence_co: The Core of the Transcendental itself.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnium_block.l: A solid cube of the metal that is every metal at once. It weighs exactly what I expect it to weigh, whatever that is, and it rings with every resonant frequency simultaneously.
block.theoreticalsciences.omnium_energy_: The last word in storage. Omnium lines the walls, the Omega Point sits at its heart, and the energy inside no longer obeys the usual bookkeeping.
block.theoreticalsciences.ordinal_ore.lo: Ore whose crystals arrive in sequence: each one has a definite successor, and even infinite chains of them have a limit crystal waiting beyond. Found in the Transfinite Hierarchy, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Ordinal Shard when mined. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.ordinal_recurs: Counts past infinity: takes a limit, adds one, and keeps going - omega, omega plus one, omega times two, omega squared, epsilon-naught...
Stone laid down in well-ordered strata. Every layer has a next one, and every collection of layers has a first; even the infinite stacks have a successor waiting above them.
block.theoreticalsciences.particle_spect: Separates a spray of particles by mass and charge: quark flavours, leptons and gauge bosons, one by one.
block.theoreticalsciences.peano_engine.l: Builds number systems the way mathematicians did: zero, then "the next one", then negatives, fractions, reals and beyond.
block.theoreticalsciences.penrose_ergosp: Extracts the rotational energy of a spinning black hole via the Penrose process.
block.theoreticalsciences.photoresist.lo: Quantum-Dot Photoresist, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
Armour for working at the smallest length that means anything.
Slices boules into wafers, and wafers into dies, along cuts one Planck length wide.
block.theoreticalsciences.plasma_crucibl: A casing of chronosteel around magnetic confinement and superconducting coils, built to hold plasma at stellar temperatures for as long as needed.
block.theoreticalsciences.plasma_injecti: A nozzle that fires plasma into a confinement chamber at a precisely controlled rate. Magnetic confinement steers it, a cryocooler keeps the coils cold, and the tip glows white when in use.
block.theoreticalsciences.pleroma.lore: Pleroma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.pleroma_conflu: Fills with a million mB of every fluid of the mod (and of every mod's Essence) and condenses them into Pleroma.
Glass rated for what the structure behind it holds back - light gets out, nothing else does.
block.theoreticalsciences.pleroma_recons: A cathedral of Absolute Frame and Pleroma Glass around a Logos-wound throat. Fed the Echo of the Transcendental and everything the Sundering left, it plays the echo back - until the dimension it remembers exists again.
block.theoreticalsciences.polished_chere: Cherenkov quartz polished until its surface is glassy and its glow is even across the whole face. In a dark room it gives off a cool blue light like water around a reactor core.
block.theoreticalsciences.polished_dilit: Dilithium polished to a mirror finish, its violet colour deep and even. It rings very faintly when touched, and a room of it seems to hum one long note.
block.theoreticalsciences.precision_asse: A casing of neutronium plate around a photonic processor and a femtoscale inductor, built so that nothing inside it vibrates by more than a fraction of a proton. It is dead silent and dead still.
block.theoreticalsciences.prime_number_o: Axiom stone threaded with veins that appear only at prime positions - never at a composite one, and never in a pattern I can predict. Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 0 and 200. Gives Prime Shard when mined. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.primordial_law: Primordial Law, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.primordial_sou: Primordial Soup, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.proof_assistan: Checks proofs one axiom at a time. Logic, set theory and category theory are all built here.
block.theoreticalsciences.proof_floor.lo: The foundation of the proof, the ground everything rests on. Its surface is etched with axioms, plain and unhurried, and nothing built above it can sink through.
block.theoreticalsciences.proof_membrane: A thin, translucent barrier between one stage of the argument and the next. It parts only once the preceding step is established, letting me through like a lemma admitted into the main proof.
block.theoreticalsciences.proof_wall.lor: A wall of Living Proof, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.quadrupole_foc: A quadrupole magnet with four pole tips that squeeze a particle beam in one direction while stretching it in the other. Pairs of them focus a beam the way lenses focus light.
block.theoreticalsciences.quantum_entang: Spontaneous parametric down-conversion splits photons into entangled pairs, then binds them into qubits.
block.theoreticalsciences.quantum_error_: A core that protects a quantum computer's fragile states by spreading each logical qubit across many physical ones and fixing errors as they happen. It hums with a steady, careful rhythm.
block.theoreticalsciences.quantum_lithog: Engraves logic onto wafers through a lens. The lens is a catalyst and is never consumed.
block.theoreticalsciences.quark_gluon_co: A ring accelerator that smashes heavy nuclei into quark-gluon plasma.
block.theoreticalsciences.quark_gluon_pl: Quark-Gluon Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.raw_star_matte: Raw Star Matter, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.reality_compil: If the universe is a simulation, this decompiles it.
block.theoreticalsciences.reality_lattic: A casing that contains computronium and a Bekenstein crystal to keep track of every bit of information inside it.
block.theoreticalsciences.reheating_plas: Reheating Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.relativity_bre: Relativity Breakdown, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.renormalised_e: Renormalised Essence, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.research_nexus: A ring of error-corrected cores around a well of light that reads Research Dossiers and studies them in your place, shortening whatever you are researching.
block.theoreticalsciences.research_termi: Where research is done: spend Insight here to study what comes next.
block.theoreticalsciences.resonance_pede: The first grade of Convergence pedestal: set an item on it around a Convergence Altar.
block.theoreticalsciences.retrocausal_or: Ore that knows when it is going to be mined. Found in the White Hole Interior, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Retrocausal Crystal when mined. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.return_rift.lo: A tear in the fabric that leads back the way I came. Its edges shimmer in the colours of the home dimension, and the air nearby smells faintly of ordinary rain.
block.theoreticalsciences.rf_acceleratin: A resonant cavity driven by a tachyon klystron that gives each passing particle a precisely timed kick. Inside, radio waves bounce in a standing pattern. It hums at a frequency I can feel in my teeth.
block.theoreticalsciences.rift_frame_cas: A casing reinforced against tearing open: void lattice, graviton crystal and chronosteel over a hyperframe.
block.theoreticalsciences.schrodinger_li: Schrödinger's Limit, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.singularity_co: Feed it a great many of one item and it compacts them into a singularity - no timer, as fast as you feed it.
block.theoreticalsciences.singularity_en: At the centre of this cell sits a tiny singularity, wrapped in cosmic neutronium. Energy falls into it and is held behind the horizon until it is needed.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_allo: Nine spacetime alloy ingots pressed into one block. The alloy bends spacetime around itself slightly, so the block's edges never look quite square. It is cold and surprisingly light for its size.
A grade of structure coil. Better coils make the machines built with them faster - hold Shift to see which.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_anch: A pylon that pins a patch of spacetime in place, built around a spacetime anchor core and a chronosteel coil. The ground around it feels unusually solid, as if gravity had made its mind up.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_bric: Spacetime alloy bricks stacked in an offset pattern. The wall seems slightly curved even when perfectly straight, and its shadows fall a fraction off where they should.
A slab of Spacetime Bricks, for building with.
Stairs of Spacetime Bricks, for building with.
A wall of Spacetime Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_casi: A machine casing: the shell a structure is built from. Hold Shift to see which structures use it.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_pane: A panel of spacetime alloy whose surface seems to bend inward slightly, as if the wall behind it were further away than it is. It is cool, smooth and very faintly disorienting to look at for long.
block.theoreticalsciences.spacetime_tile: Spacetime alloy cut into tiles that never quite look square. Each tile bends the space around it a fraction, so the grid seems to ripple gently as I walk across it.
A slab of Spacetime Tiles, for building with.
Stairs of Spacetime Tiles, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.stellar_contai: A plate of degenerate armour and spacetime alloy over magnetic confinement casing, built to hold back the pressure and heat of a star. It is impossibly heavy and faintly warm.
block.theoreticalsciences.stellar_frame_: A casing of neutronium plate over event horizon casing with a Higgs field capacitor to steady its mass. It is built to hold the weight and heat of a star, and it glows faintly gold at the seams.
block.theoreticalsciences.stellar_lamp.l: A stellar frame casing with glowstone at its heart, so it shines with a warm, golden light like a small star seen through a window. It is warm to stand next to.
block.theoreticalsciences.stellar_plasma: Stellar Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
Melts and alloys matter in plasma as hot as a stellar core. Makes Chronosteel, Spacetime Alloy, Cosmic Neutronium and Exotic Solder.
block.theoreticalsciences.strange_matter: Strange Matter, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.string_resonan: Plucks cosmic strings into fundamental quantum strings and weaves them into membranes.
block.theoreticalsciences.superconductin: A drum of superconducting coil wound around spacetime casing. Current, once started, circulates in it forever with no loss at all. The field it makes tugs gently at anything metal nearby.
Superconducting Solder, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.supercritical_: Supercritical Solvent, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.superfluid_hel: Superfluid Helium, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.synaptic_fluid: Synaptic Fluid, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.synchrotron.lo: A ring accelerator built from real beamline parts: bending dipoles, focusing quadrupoles, RF cavities, cryogenics, vacuum pumps and a detector hall. It makes the exotic hadrons nothing else can.
block.theoreticalsciences.tachyon_resona: Resonates a crystal lattice until it emits particles that travel faster than light.
Computes in curved spacetime: Lorentz transformations, metrics, curvature and finally Einstein's field equations.
block.theoreticalsciences.tesseract_asse: Folds matter through a fourth spatial dimension.
block.theoreticalsciences.thermoelectric: A furnace wrapped in thermocouples: the heat of ordinary fuel, turned straight into current by the Seebeck effect. Humble - and the first power any laboratory has.
block.theoreticalsciences.tidal_ore.lore: A seam of metal pulled thin by gravity gradients. Found in the Black Hole Interior, between Y 20 and 256. Gives Tidal Alloy Scrap when mined. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.topological_tr: Changes a material's topology without changing its chemistry.
block.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_c: A box beyond every law. Holds 243 kinds of item, up to 2,147,483,647 of each, and keeps them when broken.
block.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_g: Glass that is transparent to more than light. Looking through it, I see the room beyond and, faintly, the rules that make the room possible.
block.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_p: Transcendent Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
Four plasma injectors fire into a coil-wrapped chamber hotter than a hypernova. Burns catalyst plasmas to forge metals whose properties are chosen rather than discovered.
block.theoreticalsciences.transcendent_s: Rock that no longer remembers which universe formed it. It has the solid presence of stone but none of the expected minerals, and its surface shifts colour faintly with my mood.
block.theoreticalsciences.transcendental: Axiom stone shot through with crystals of transcendental numbers - pi, e and their kin, which are not roots of any polynomial. Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 0 and 200. Gives Transcendental Crystal when mined. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.transfinite_ca: A casing built to hold infinities: a transfinite weave over reality lattice casing, with a Russell set and a Banach-Tarski sphere worked into the seams.
block.theoreticalsciences.transfinite_co: A coil of hypernova alloy wound around an aleph-null shard over a cosmic neutronium coil, superconducting at room temperature. It carries a current that never quite finishes counting itself.
block.theoreticalsciences.turbomolecular: A pump whose rotor spins so fast that its blades knock gas molecules out of the chamber one by one. It whines at a pitch just below hearing. Ultra-high vacuum starts here.
block.theoreticalsciences.universe_forge: Triggers false-vacuum decay and cosmic inflation to grow - and later harvest - a pocket universe.
block.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_beam_pi: A pipe of containment field glass and metamaterial lined with Casimir plates, so the space inside is emptier than empty. A particle beam runs through it without touching anything at all.
block.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_energy_: Energy borrowed from the vacuum itself, stored with exotic matter to keep the books balanced. Inside, graviton crystal holds the field taut while a dark matter lens focuses it.
block.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_harvest: Holds a bubble of false vacuum open in the Quantum Foam and catches the virtual particles that flicker through it. What it catches depends on where it stands and how it is tuned.
block.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_state_p: A projector that changes what empty space is. Exotic matter in its core shifts the vacuum energy of the region it covers, so the field inside is a slightly different universe.
block.theoreticalsciences.virtual_gravit: A vein where gravity itself fizzes. Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Graviton when mined. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.virtual_monopo: A vein that points only one way. Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Monopole when mined. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.virtual_photon: Glints of light that do not come from anywhere. Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Photon when mined. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.virtual_quark_: Quarks borrowed from the vacuum and caught before they could be returned. Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Quark when mined. Needs an iron pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_bricks.lo: Void lattice cut into bricks - rigid blocks of nothing stacked with careful joints. The wall looks like a pattern of very clean holes in the world.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_bricks_sl: A slab of Void Lattice Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_bricks_st: Stairs of Void Lattice Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_bricks_wa: A wall of Void Lattice Bricks, for building with.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_lattice_b: Void lattice shards compacted into a block - a crystal of empty sites that is rigid even though there is nothing in it. Looking at it feels like looking at a hole in the world with very clean edges.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_lattice_o: Bulk stone holding pockets of a crystal made of nothing - a lattice of empty sites that remains rigid even though there is nothing in them. Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 128. Gives Void Lattice Shard when mined. Needs a diamond pickaxe or better.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_pillar.lo: A column of void lattice, rigid emptiness standing upright. It carries weight without any matter inside it, which still seems wrong every time I look at it.
block.theoreticalsciences.void_tiles.lor: Void lattice cut into flat tiles. A floor of them looks like standing on a grid laid over nothing at all, and it is perfectly solid underfoot.
block.theoreticalsciences.white_hole_emi: Runs a black hole backwards in time. Nothing can enter; everything comes out.
block.theoreticalsciences.wormhole_frame: A casing threaded with negative mass and exotic matter, the ingredients a traversable wormhole needs to keep its throat open.
block.theoreticalsciences.wormhole_proje: Opens a traversable wormhole to distant stars and drags their matter through.
block.theoreticalsciences.xenoplasm.lore: Xenoplasm, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.
block.theoreticalsciences.zero_point_ext: Generates power from vacuum fluctuations. Burns Casimir plates and exotic matter as catalysts.
boss.theoreticalsciences.alpha_omega.gen: I am what your engine was made of: every law you broke apart to build it.
You took the universe to pieces. Do you understand any of them?
Why does a clock slow down? What is a measurement? How many infinities are there?
And why did you do it - to make, to know, or to be?
Come inside. Show me what you understand.
boss.theoreticalsciences.alpha_omega.pro: One last question. Everything depends on it.
boss.theoreticalsciences.alpha_omega.shi: It has closed itself into a proof. Answer at the pedestals.
Its Echo has been played back into being. Everything exists again.

It was never abnormal, only unexplained. Unlocks the Resolved Anomaly.
research.theoreticalsciences.anomaly_sca: What can an anomaly do, and how big can it get? Catalogue them, and their sizes - tumours, outbreaks, avalanches, ruptures - follow power laws: most are tiny, a few are vast, and the mean is set by the exponent. Unlocks the Anomaly Catalogue.
research.theoreticalsciences.antiatom_ch: An antiproton and a positron make antihydrogen - with exactly the same spectrum as hydrogen. Unlocks the Antiproton Decelerator.
research.theoreticalsciences.artificial_: Photonic neural networks and narrow AI. Unlocks the Neural Synthesizer.
research.theoreticalsciences.assembly_li: Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.
research.theoreticalsciences.autocatalys: A reaction whose product speeds up its own making grows exponentially and can oscillate, flare and spread as a wave. A prion does it with shape alone: a misfolded protein that refolds the healthy ones it touches. Unlocks Autocatalytic Broth and the Prion Lattice.
research.theoreticalsciences.axiom_theor: Beneath the source code of reality lie its axioms - and axioms can be distilled, edited and broken. Unlocks the Axiom Distiller.
research.theoreticalsciences.baryon_asym: For every billion antibaryons in the early universe there were a billion and one baryons. We are the one. Unlocks the Baryogenesis Seed.
research.theoreticalsciences.beyond_the_: With the Proof of Everything, the Omnilex Engine can be pushed past the possible - into the Transcendental.
research.theoreticalsciences.big_bang_co: Everything we see was once hotter and denser than the inside of any star, and has been expanding and cooling ever since. The Friedmann equations of general relativity say how fast: by what fills the universe and how it is curved. The first study of the Origin.
research.theoreticalsciences.big_crunch: The Big Crunch & the Big Bounce
Enough matter, or dark energy that decays, and the expansion stops and reverses: everything falls back into a crunch. Quantum geometry may refuse the singularity - at the Planck density gravity repels, and the crunch bounces into a new expansion. Unlocks the Bounce Core.
research.theoreticalsciences.big_rip.des: If dark energy is phantom - w below -1 - its density grows as space expands. Clusters, then galaxies, then stars and planets, then atoms are torn apart, all in a finite time. Unlocks the Phantom Energy Cell.
research.theoreticalsciences.black_hole_: After the protons, only black holes are left, slowly radiating. A black hole of a solar mass needs 10^67 years to evaporate, a supermassive one 10^100 - and then it ends in a flash. Unlocks the Last Flash of a Black Hole.
What is past the horizon - and, through an Einstein-Rosen bridge, what is past the white hole's. Unlocks the Horizon Diver and the Geodesic Anchor.
research.theoreticalsciences.brane_cosmo: Our universe is a membrane floating in the Bulk. The Brane Shifter can take you there.
research.theoreticalsciences.calculus.de: Infinitesimals, derivatives and integrals - and manifolds, the spaces calculus lives on.
research.theoreticalsciences.casimir_eff: Two plates in a vacuum attract: empty space is full of energy. Unlocks the Casimir Press and Zero-Point Extractor.
research.theoreticalsciences.category_th: Objects and arrows. Functors between categories, and toposes - universes with their own logic.
research.theoreticalsciences.causality_v: Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.
research.theoreticalsciences.chemical_bo: Atoms share electrons because a shared wavefunction has lower energy. Unlocks the Chemical Reactor.
research.theoreticalsciences.chronodynam: If time is quantised, its quanta can be stored.
research.theoreticalsciences.clonal_evol: A tumour is a population, and populations evolve. Every treatment selects the few cells that happen to resist it; they inherit the tumour. Drug resistance is not learned but chosen - by the treatment itself. Unlocks the Resistant Clone Colony.
research.theoreticalsciences.compact_sta: Neutron stars, magnetars, pulsars and quark stars - the densest objects short of a singularity.
research.theoreticalsciences.compactific: Where are the extra dimensions? Rolled up too small to see. Unlocks the Compactification Lathe.
research.theoreticalsciences.complex_ana: Add the square root of minus one and every polynomial has its roots. Fourier series and fractals follow.
research.theoreticalsciences.component_t: Better coils run hotter and unlock heavier recipes; better field emitters let a multiblock run more parallels. A structure is only as good as its weakest part.
research.theoreticalsciences.conceptual_: Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.
research.theoreticalsciences.conformal_c: At the end of time only massless things remain, and massless things cannot tell an infinite distance from a finite one. Rescale the dead universe and its infinite future becomes the Big Bang of the next aeon. Where Finality ends, Origin begins: make a Universe Seed from the end of a universe.
research.theoreticalsciences.conquered_a: You understood. It let you go.
research.theoreticalsciences.containment: To study an anomaly you must keep it alive; to keep the world safe you must keep it from spreading. Quarantine is the art of clearing it just faster than it copies itself - R below 1, and not much below. Unlocks the Quarantine Field Matrix.
research.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_esch: How does a universe end? Its fate is written in what fills it: matter decelerates the expansion, dark energy accelerates it, and the equation of state w decides whether it freezes, rips or collapses. The first study of Finality.
research.theoreticalsciences.cosmic_infl: Why is the universe so flat, so smooth, and the same in every direction - even regions that could never have touched? Because a scalar field, the inflaton, made space grow by e sixty times over in 10^-32 seconds. Unlocks the Inflation Chamber and Inflaton Condensate.
research.theoreticalsciences.cosmogenesi: False vacuum decay plus inflation equals a new universe. Then harvest it.
research.theoreticalsciences.cpt_symmetr: Reverse charge, parity and time together and the laws of physics do not change. Somewhere, then, there is a universe of antimatter. Unlocks the CPT Mirror and the Penning Harness.
Near absolute zero, matter forgets it is many particles. Superfluids and Bose-Einstein condensates.
research.theoreticalsciences.dark_energy: The energy of empty space itself, pushing galaxies apart.
research.theoreticalsciences.dark_sector: Most of the universe's mass does not interact with light. Unlocks the Dark Matter Halo Collector.
research.theoreticalsciences.directed_ev: A million generations in a minute, if time runs fast enough. Unlocks the Evolution Engine and telomerase.
research.theoreticalsciences.dyson_spher: Close the swarm into a shell and capture a star's entire output.
research.theoreticalsciences.electrochem: Chemistry is electrons moving; push them with a voltage. Unlocks the Electrolytic Cell.
research.theoreticalsciences.entangled_l: Two particles, one state - and so one channel. Unlocks Entangled Relays, Transceivers and the Entanglement Tuner.
research.theoreticalsciences.epidemic_dy: Between hosts, an infection is a reproduction number. Above R = 1 it spreads through a population; below it, it dies out - a phase transition, the same as water freezing or a fluid percolating through porous rock. Unlocks the Contagion Network Map.
research.theoreticalsciences.exotic_chem: Chemistry with muons, positrons and antimatter instead of electrons. Unlocks positronium hydride and muonic catalysts.
research.theoreticalsciences.extremophil: Life at the edges: boiling vents, frozen vacuum, radiation. Unlocks tardigrade cultures.
research.theoreticalsciences.femtoengine: Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.
research.theoreticalsciences.field_engin: Gravity, dimension, time and the vacuum are all fields - and fields can be projected. Unlocks the Field Projectors, the Graviton Harness and the Chronal Anchor.
research.theoreticalsciences.formal_logi: Axioms, inference rules, proofs. Unlocks the Formal Proof Assistant and the Empty Set.
research.theoreticalsciences.fractional_: High-tier processes leave Dimensional Residue. Distil it back into useful matter in the Fractionation Spire.
research.theoreticalsciences.general_int: A mind that can learn anything.
research.theoreticalsciences.general_rel: Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.
research.theoreticalsciences.genomics.de: Four letters, three billion of them. Unlocks the Gene Sequencer, recombinant DNA and engineered enzymes.
research.theoreticalsciences.geometric_t: Surfaces with one side and bottles with no inside.
research.theoreticalsciences.grand_unifi: At high enough energy, three forces become one.
The likeliest end of all: endless expansion to maximum entropy. Stars burn out, protons decay, black holes evaporate, and an empty de Sitter space is left, glowing at the temperature of its own horizon. Unlocks the Entropy Horizon.
research.theoreticalsciences.holographic: Everything inside a volume is encoded on its boundary - black holes included.
research.theoreticalsciences.horizon_sim: A black hole is the densest possible computer. Feed it a star and it will simulate one. Unlocks the Eye of the Event Horizon.
research.theoreticalsciences.hyperdimens: Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.
The space outside every universe, where universes grow on a tree and laws are born from an ocean.
research.theoreticalsciences.immune_evas: To survive, an anomaly must escape everything built to remove it: hide its markers from the immune system, switch telomerase back on and forget how to age, grow its own blood vessels, and finally leave - slip into the blood and seed itself somewhere new. Unlocks the Immortal Cell Line and the Metastatic Spore.
research.theoreticalsciences.incompleten: Any system strong enough to describe arithmetic contains truths it can never prove - reality included.
research.theoreticalsciences.invasion_fr: No anomaly grows alone. It recruits blood vessels and stroma, signals to the cells around it, and invades as a travelling front whose speed is set by how fast it grows and how far it diffuses - the same mathematics as a cellular automaton spreading on a grid. Unlocks the Tumour Microenvironment Organoid.
research.theoreticalsciences.island_of_s: Past the end of the periodic table, magic numbers promise superheavy nuclei that last. Unlocks the Nuclide Forge.
research.theoreticalsciences.leptogenesi: Matter and antimatter should have annihilated perfectly. They did not: heavy neutrinos decayed out of equilibrium, unequally to leptons and antileptons, and sphalerons turned the excess into baryons - one in a billion. Unlocks the Baryon Asymmetry Crystal.
research.theoreticalsciences.m_theory.de: Strings are the edges of membranes in eleven dimensions.
research.theoreticalsciences.mass_manipu: Massless matter, negative mass and the inertial dampers every starship needs.
research.theoreticalsciences.matrioshka_: Wrap a star in nested shells of computronium and let it think.
research.theoreticalsciences.metamateria: Engineered structures with a negative refractive index.
research.theoreticalsciences.mirror_meta: Metals that must never touch anything. Unlocks the Mirror Matter Foundry, anti-metals and the Mirror Alloy.
research.theoreticalsciences.molecular_b: Life is chemistry that copies itself. Unlocks the Bioreactor, Nutrient Broth and the Gene Sampler.
research.theoreticalsciences.morphogenes: How a blob of identical cells paints itself into a body: reaction and diffusion. Unlocks Turing morphogens.
Other branes, other constants, other universes - and a way to reach them.
research.theoreticalsciences.nanochemist: Carbon one atom thick, rolled, folded and caged. Unlocks graphene, nanotubes and buckyballs.
research.theoreticalsciences.nanotechnol: Assemblers that build anything atom by atom - including copies of themselves.
research.theoreticalsciences.neurobiolog: Grow a brain in a dish and ask it what it thinks. Unlocks neural organoids.
research.theoreticalsciences.neutrino_ph: Ghost particles, trillions of which pass through you every second.
research.theoreticalsciences.nucleosynth: Every element heavier than helium was made in a star. Iron is where fusion stops; supernovae make the rest.
research.theoreticalsciences.number_syst: Zero, and "the next one". From two rules, all of arithmetic. Unlocks the Peano Arithmetic Engine.
research.theoreticalsciences.number_theo: Primes, modular forms and the Riemann zeta function - the hardest problems in mathematics are about whole numbers.
research.theoreticalsciences.omnilex.des: Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.
research.theoreticalsciences.oncogenesis: A cancer is not one mistake but several: an oncogene stuck on, a tumour suppressor like p53 lost, a checkpoint skipped - each a mutation that gives one cell an advantage over its neighbours. The hallmarks of cancer are what that cell has learned. Unlocks the Anomalous Strain Culture.
Life carried between worlds - and between universes. Unlocks panspermia seeds and the omnicellular genome.
research.theoreticalsciences.paradox_eng: Russell sets and Banach-Tarski spheres: building with contradictions.
research.theoreticalsciences.particle_ph: Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.
research.theoreticalsciences.pathologica: Mathematics has its monsters too: curves continuous everywhere and smooth nowhere, sets with no size, systems so sensitive that they are deterministic and unpredictable at once, and questions no algorithm can decide. They were never errors - only the parts of the theory that had not been explained yet. Unlocks the Undecidable Kernel.
research.theoreticalsciences.penrose_pro: Energy can be stolen from a rotating black hole's ergosphere.
research.theoreticalsciences.plasma_meta: Alloys forged in stellar plasma: Chronosteel and Exotic Solder. Unlocks the Stellar Plasma Crucible.
research.theoreticalsciences.platonic_re: If mathematical objects exist somewhere, they exist here. Unlocks the Platonic Compass.
research.theoreticalsciences.pleroma.des: The fullness of everything: every fluid there is, poured together. Unlocks the Pleroma Confluence.
research.theoreticalsciences.poincare_re: A dead universe is not quite dead. In a finite system at equilibrium every state comes back, given time, and fluctuations out of equilibrium happen by pure chance - a star, a planet, a brain. Unlocks the Boltzmann Fluctuation.
research.theoreticalsciences.precision_l: Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.
research.theoreticalsciences.primordial_: For three minutes the whole universe was a fusion reactor. Neutrons froze out at one in six, decayed a little, and were swept into helium-4: a quarter of all matter, as measured. Unlocks Primordial Nucleosynthesis Ash.
research.theoreticalsciences.protein_fol: A chain finds its one shape among astronomically many. Unlocks folded protein crystals.
research.theoreticalsciences.proton_deca: Grand unified theories join quarks and leptons, so even a proton can change into a positron and a pion. Its lifetime is at least 10^34 years - and after the last star, the degenerate era ends when every proton is gone. Unlocks Proton Decay Residue.
research.theoreticalsciences.psionics.de: Thought, crystallised. A science that should not exist.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_bio: Photosynthesis, enzymes and migrating birds all use quantum coherence. Unlocks quantum chlorophyll and magnetoreceptors.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_che: Solve the Schrödinger equation for a molecule and you have its chemistry. Unlocks orbital lattices and chiral crystals.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_cos: Before inflation, before time: a closed universe can tunnel into existence from no space at all, or begin without a boundary, its time becoming space near the start like the South Pole of a sphere. Quantum cosmology writes the wave function of the whole universe. Unlocks the No-Boundary Seed.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_ent: Spooky action at a distance, put to work. Unlocks qubits and the Quantum Entangler.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_fie: Particles are excitations of fields. Wave packets, spinors, field lattices and Feynman diagrams.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_foa: Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_fou: Everything is a wave until it is measured. Catalogue phenomena with the Spectral Analyzer to begin.
research.theoreticalsciences.quantum_gra: Gravitons and spin foam: spacetime made of quanta. Unlocks the Graviton Condenser.
research.theoreticalsciences.real_analys: Limits, continuity and the completion of the rationals into the reals. Unlocks the Analytic Continuator.
research.theoreticalsciences.reality_bre: Break every law of physics and mathematics at once, and step through the hole. Unlocks the Axiomatic Breach Engine and the Axiom Key.
research.theoreticalsciences.reheating.d: Inflation leaves space empty and cold. When the inflaton reaches the bottom of its potential it oscillates and decays, and its energy becomes a hot plasma of every particle there is: the hot Big Bang begins here. Unlocks Reheating Plasma.
research.theoreticalsciences.research_sy: Teach a machine to study. Unlocks the Research Nexus and Empirical Dossiers; later dossiers come with later research.
research.theoreticalsciences.self_replic: A program that prints itself, a machine that builds itself from a description of itself, a virus, a rumour: every replicator holds a copy of its own instructions. Whether its lineage survives is a branching process - it dies out unless each copy makes more than one more. Unlocks the Quine Replicator.
Everything is a set. Power sets, the continuum, and the axiom of choice.
research.theoreticalsciences.simulation_: If reality is computed, it can be decompiled - and edited.
research.theoreticalsciences.singularity: Event horizons, Hawking radiation and the Kugelblitz: a black hole made from light alone.
research.theoreticalsciences.special_rel: The speed of light is the same for everyone - so time and space cannot be. Unlocks the Tensor Calculus Engine.
research.theoreticalsciences.standard_mo: Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.
research.theoreticalsciences.stellar_eng: Ignite a captive star from white-hole ejecta.
research.theoreticalsciences.stellar_evo: Stars are born from nebulae, live on the main sequence, swell into giants and die. Unlocks the Nucleosynthesis Chamber.
research.theoreticalsciences.stellar_tra: Above stellar-core temperatures, matter stops having fixed properties. Unlocks the Transcendent Plasma Forge.
research.theoreticalsciences.string_theo: Every particle is a vibrating string. Unlocks the String Resonance Loom.
research.theoreticalsciences.superacid_c: Acids a million million times stronger than sulfuric - strong enough to protonate almost anything.
research.theoreticalsciences.superconduc: Cooper pairs that hold together at room temperature, inside a hydrogen-rich framework.
research.theoreticalsciences.superintell: A mind that improves itself. Computronium becomes possible.
research.theoreticalsciences.supersymmet: Every boson has a fermion twin. The lightest of them is dark matter.
research.theoreticalsciences.supramolecu: Molecules that build themselves into cages, frameworks and machines. Unlocks MOFs, clathrates and self-healing polymers.
research.theoreticalsciences.symbiosis_p: Two populations that share a world either compete, prey, or help. A parasite and a symbiont can be the same organism with one interaction coefficient flipped - mitochondria were invaders once. The boundary between anomaly and normality is a sign. Unlocks the Symbiont Culture.
research.theoreticalsciences.synthetic_b: Write life instead of reading it. Unlocks synthetic cells, xenobots and stem cell cultures.
Hypothetical faster-than-light particles. Their imaginary mass makes them slow down as they gain energy.
research.theoreticalsciences.targeted_th: Kill the anomaly, spare the normal: CRISPR-written triggers that make only anomalous cells accept apoptosis, CAR-T cells taught to hunt one marker, and dose split into fractions the normal tissue can repair between. Unlocks the Anomaly Resolution Engine, the Apoptosis Trigger and CAR-T Cell Culture.
research.theoreticalsciences.temporal_me: The arrow of time, and how to tie it in knots without causing a paradox. Unlocks the Chrono Loom.
research.theoreticalsciences.the_rekindl: The Transcendental exists again, and the Core with it - now able to forge what even it could not simply make.
research.theoreticalsciences.the_sunderi: You told Omnipotence to stop, and it did. From its shards: Omnipotence Dust, the Apeiron Ingot, the Pleroma Crystal, Logos Thread - and the Pleroma Reconstitutor.
research.theoreticalsciences.theory_of_e: Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model as one theory.
research.theoreticalsciences.thermodynam: Information is physical. A demon that knows which molecules are fast can sort them and reverse entropy.
research.theoreticalsciences.topological: When a field cools and must choose between equal vacua, distant regions choose differently - and where they meet, the old symmetry is trapped in a wall, a string or a knot that cannot be smoothed away. Pockets of false vacuum survive the same way. Unlocks the Topological Defect Core.
research.theoreticalsciences.topology.de: Phases of matter protected by topology rather than symmetry.
research.theoreticalsciences.transfinite: Ordinals count past infinity; cardinals measure it. Both have a place of their own - with the objects of higher dimensions. Unlocks the Cantor Key and the Ordinal Recursor.
Cantor proved that some infinities are bigger than others. Build them. Unlocks the Cantor Diagonalizer.
research.theoreticalsciences.traversable: Black and white holes joined at the throat, propped open with negative mass.
research.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_deca: If our vacuum is only metastable, a bubble of the true vacuum may nucleate somewhere, someday. Its wall sweeps outwards at nearly the speed of light, and inside it the laws of physics are different. There would be no warning. Unlocks the True Vacuum Seed.
research.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_ener: Store energy in the difference between two vacua. Unlocks the Energy Cells.
research.theoreticalsciences.vacuum_stab: What could stop a universe from starting at all? A vacuum energy a little larger and it would fly apart before stars formed; a Higgs coupling a little smaller and the vacuum would be unstable. Ours sits, by measurement, at the edge: metastable. Unlocks the Metastable Vacuum Lattice.
research.theoreticalsciences.white_holes: The time-reverse of a black hole: a horizon nothing can enter.
research.theoreticalsciences.xenobiology: Life in other dimensions does not use DNA. Unlocks xenogenome work, Xenoplasm and silicon life.
scepter.theoreticalsciences.mode.big_ban: A new universe for an instant: a vast blast that leaves every block untouched

scepter.theoreticalsciences.mode.white_h: Matter pours out of nothing, hurling everything nearby away and hurting it

transit.theoreticalsciences.white_hole_i: Time runs backwards here: nothing may enter, everything is thrown out.
